visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two Corgis stand on a light brown tiled floor, looking up at the camera with curiosity. The camera operator is seen from a high-angle POV wearing white trousers and black loafers. In the background, green plastic crates are stacked against a wall near an open doorway. (2) The owner reaches down with their right arm, which features a prominent black-ink tattoo and a large smartwatch, to pet the Corgis. Both dogs react with excitement, opening their mouths and wagging their bodies vigorously. The lighting is bright and natural from the open door. (3) One Corgi rolls onto its back on the tiles, displaying its belly for scratches while the other dog nudges the owner's hand. Cardboard boxes, including some labeled 'Taiwan Beer', are visible in the corner of the room. The interaction is lively and playful throughout.
